metrics.label: Tasks
metrics.detail: Explicit Task, detached, async-let and possible group additions. Not a runtime task total.

metrics.label: Unstructured Tasks
metrics.detail: Warning: the creator does not automatically wait or pass on cancellation. Includes detached Tasks; inspect explicit lifetime management.

metrics.label: Detached Tasks
metrics.detail: Included in Unstructured Tasks; created using Task.detached.

metrics.label: Child Tasks
metrics.detail: Async-let bindings plus possible group additions. One site may create many children.

metrics.label: Parallel child Tasks
metrics.detail: Requires a runtime trace. Structured child tasks permit concurrency; simultaneous execution is not guaranteed.

metrics.label: Sequential awaits
metrics.detail: Requires control-flow analysis; keyword counts do not prove an execution sequence.

metrics.label: Await
metrics.detail: Potential suspension syntax, including handle awaits and for-await. Not actual suspensions.

metrics.label: SwiftUI Tasks
metrics.detail: Task modifiers and refresh callbacks; separate from explicit task creation.

metrics.label: ViewModel Tasks
metrics.detail: Explicit task declarations in ViewModel-named files; not runtime ownership.

metrics.label: Model Tasks
metrics.detail: Explicit task declarations in model-classified files, using folder and filename heuristics.

metrics.label: UI · MainActor annotations
metrics.detail: Explicit annotations in UI-classified files. Does not measure inferred isolation or UI correctness.

metrics.label: Model · MainActor annotations
metrics.detail: Explicit annotations in model-classified files (folder and filename heuristics). Does not measure workload or business-logic volume.

dashboard.isolation: MainActor is appropriate for observable state and UI coordination. Annotation counts cannot distinguish short state updates from expensive feature work.
dashboard.coverage: Source inventory with optional author-supplied journey observations; no runtime measurements.

method: Lexical source inventory — not compiler-resolved or runtime-observed

scope.targetMembership: Not resolved; inactive compilation branches may be included

limitations: Matches are source matches: similarly named custom APIs may match; wrappers and unusual syntax may be missed.
String interpolation bodies and Swift regex literals are not fully parsed. Source offsets use UTF-16 code units.
No call graph, task-parent relationships, inferred isolation, runtime timings or automatic race proof.
Task-group scopes and possible child sites are separate; neither is a runtime task count.
Naming-based architecture roles and UI responsibility warnings require human or AI semantic review.
No quality score or UI-cleanliness percentage is computed from these heuristics.
